Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2-by-2 sprite atlas for woodland animal siege game. Supplied image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, matching its rich painterly wood grain, honey sunlight, charming fantasy craft and crisp silhouettes. Make THREE isolated open double wooden gateway sprites, one in each specified quarter; leave the fourth quarter entirely transparent. ONE square image, true alpha transparent background. No text, grid lines, labels, animals, people, castle building, ground tile, scenery, or closed doors.
CRITICAL: Each gateway has two sturdy short posts joined by a readable carved timber lintel across the TOP, and TWO wood-plank DOOR LEAVES physically attached at the side posts, swung WIDE OPEN OUTWARD toward the viewer at about 70 degrees. Their carved front faces are visible at the sides. The CENTER HALF of the gateway is an empty clear transparent passage from beneath the overhead lintel all the way down to its base. DO NOT draw a solid horizontal fence, threshold plank, low brace or barrier across this walk-through opening. No doorway filled with shadow color; the central opening must be transparent so game grass and animal sprites show through. Not just two poles: hinges, angled open door panels and the top frame must read instantly. Subtly elevated three-quarter view consistent with a small square tactical tile. Tiny contact shadows only under posts. All components fully contained with ample transparent margins inside each quarter, no overlap across central seams. Each sprite occupies about 80% of its quarter's width and height.
TOP LEFT: Acorn Fort gateway, warm honey cedar frame and two outward-open golden-brown plank leaves, iron hinges and subtle carved acorn ornament at top center, no flag or sign.
TOP RIGHT: River Keep gateway, weathered bark cedar with teal rope wraps and two outward-open grey-brown plank doors with teal cross straps, natural moss touches at post bases.
BOTTOM LEFT: Treetop Citadel gateway, elegantly carved golden cedar frame with restrained ivy on the outside of posts, two wide-open golden wood door leaves and small bronze hinge studs, no symbol or flag blocking passage.
BOTTOM RIGHT: completely blank transparent quarter, no object.
High-quality hand-painted game sprites, not a flat vector icon, not a geometric schematic, not photorealism, no heavy black outlines.

Keep ONLY the wooden frames, two open door leaves, metal/rope fittings and the small ivy attached to the posts. Bottom-right quarter stays entirely empty and transparent. notes: Three open double-gate sprites. Quadrant extraction and WebP encoding only; walkable gate tile coordinates and all collision rules remain unchanged.
